subject: website
name: Swarm dOTC
summary: The Swarm Markets dOTC trading app. No public source for this build was found. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager, a Mava chat widget and a Usercentrics consent script from other hosts, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also reads several RPC endpoints, an indexer and the Swarm API.
